entities.name: Ishikawa Toyonobu
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Ishikawa Toyonobu  was a Japanese ukiyo-e print artist. He is sometimes said to have been the same person as Nishimura Shigenobu, a contemporary ukiyo-e artist and student of Nishimura Shigenaga about whom very little is known.
